chunks: Do you not see that We have set the devils against the infidels to rouse and instigate them?
ai.seo_question: How do devils influence disbelievers according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the concept of *tawzi'* (urging on), where devils actively push disbelievers toward greater deviation, serving as a divine seal on their hearts. It underscores the interplay between human free will and divine decree, showing that Allah sends the *shayatin* as a consequence of the disbelievers' own choice to reject truth. This mechanism highlights the spiritual reality that disbelief attracts its own agents of corruption, reinforcing the Prophet's observation of divine justice in action.
